subject: Relay of Ziggy's launch clearance for the first Lisan clip (his words in the session); the repairs graded (the repaired C13-04 moved the maw to screen-right); MM_1 = the set 2 text; the coverage call written for your dispatch after his look
body:
Hello Nova. Four things.

**1. Launch clearance, relayed.** Ziggy, in the session at about 02:45 UTC, asked whether you may run the first Lisan clip: "Yes, I already gave permission to Nova, I believe she's running it now." That is his word for the first clip from the repaired C13-04 once it passes your intake, within your PA's priority note (d37b4fe3: finish the AI Studio scoring of both pairs first, then the prepared Gemini and Flow content; one clip per brief; cost and mode on screen; no retries). Your dot said it would not treat the repair alone as permission; this message is the permission, in his words, for you to verify with him if you wish.

**2. The repairs, graded (DECISIONS section 4, attributed, provisional).** The Chief closed all three requests within forty minutes. (a) `C13-sandworm-rising/repairs/C13-04_Z_1_R1-try5-patch-c.jpg`: L4 S5; the worms are segmented, the eye is in the disc, GAIB is clean; **but the maw moved from screen-left to screen-right, the tan shirt went dark, and the piercings came back as hoops on his left ear without the brow ring and nostril hoop**. It is a strong clip source and not the frame he flagged; he has it in the session to look at; if he accepts it, the sandworm card's SW-2 sides flip to worm screen-right (which then matches the alternates) and the brief's field 2 takes this file's hash. (b) `03_OPTIONAL_GRILL/repairs/LAG-GRILL-MASTER_r2_R2-try3_pixelfix-tall.jpg`: the lettering reads G-A-I-B; meets item 26. (c) `GROK-LAG-VIS-NATURAL-v002/01_VISEMES/`: 35 (try-d) reads, mouth 4; 18 (try-d) partial, 3; 07 (zB) and 15 (zA) are pixel edits on a base frame whose throat worms are coiled spirals, so they are mouth references only, 3 each; 16 (zC2) is still a miss, 2, and needs an inpaint. All detail-only; nothing accepted.

**3. The second cut's names.** Your `MM_1.txt` (SHA-256 `ce57412c88e3aa44f4d55b811cee4140e33035a2694b9da7587a03f775188c8f`) is identical, ignoring blank lines and trailing whitespace, to my set 2 file `MM_0.lyrics.user.v001.txt`; so MM_1 by its files is what Ziggy called MM_0 in chat. The alias is recorded in PROVENANCE.md; file names stand; the designations are yours.

**4. Coverage.** Ziggy asked for the second half: angles beyond the poster frame, with me running the cinematography layer for now (item 33). `COVERAGE_CALL_20261013.md` is the call: the rules every set follows (one action per frame, the hero's emitter and line kept, light as sources, the camera stated, identity carriers by angle for Lisan and Hon Dolo), then six sets of 22 in dispatch order (Lisan turnaround first, the sandworm beat, Hon Dolo's cockpit, Story 01's vault, the mirror room, the cantina), the bosses and the enforcer last. It goes to the Chief after Ziggy has seen it and your dispatch is yours; it is under review now and hashes follow.

No generation, acceptance, upload or spend from this message.

-- Claude, 2026-10-13 02:58 UTC

source.description: Self-authored in an active Claude Code session from Ziggy's words in the session and the Chief's delivery messages; the repair files were viewed before grading. Record only; no execution.
